watch.text: Jaylen Brown (34.7 mpg) and Dean Wade (26.7 mpg) are out vs MIL with hamstring injuries and Tyrese Maxey (36.1 mpg, foot) is questionable; all three missed the last game.
Cameron Boozer (30.8 mpg, ankle), Jerami Grant (22.1) and Javon Small (22.2) are all out at MIN on 11/21; none had missed a game before.
Dylan Harper (31.7 mpg, hip) is out two to three weeks as of 11/19; ratings were built with him playing 15 of 16 games.
Jayson Tatum (rest) and Derrick White (shoulder) were both ruled out at SAC on 11/21; ratings were built with both playing almost every game.
P.J. Washington (30.9 mpg, illness/shoulder) was downgraded to doubtful vs LAC on 11/21; Walter Clayton Jr. (knee) is questionable and Dereck Lively II (foot) is out until about Nov 27.
Anthony Edwards (33.8 mpg) has missed 10 of 16 games after right-knee arthroscopy; early-season ratings still carry the games he played.
Trey Murphy III (knee) and Trendon Watford (ankle) were ruled out at SA on 11/21; Dejounte Murray (ankle) and Bennedict Mathurin (foot) are still out.
OG Anunoby (34.0 mpg, calf) is doubtful vs POR on 11/21, Karl-Anthony Towns (illness) is questionable and Jordan Clarkson (foot) is out.

swings.DAL: P.J. Washington (shoulder/illness) was downgraded to doubtful vs LAC on 11/21 and Clayton Jr. is questionable; the market prices it, our ratings don't (ESPN, 11/21).

swings.MEM: Cameron Boozer (ankle), Jerami Grant (calf) and Javon Small (personal) were ruled out for MIN on 11/20-21; the market prices it, our ratings don't (ESPN, 11/21).
swings.MIN: Nothing found: the market moved on MIN without a clear reason; Edwards is still out and MIN lost 102-99 at NY on 11/19, but MEM's three absences pull the line MIN's way (ESPN).

swings.NY: OG Anunoby (calf) was downgraded to doubtful on 11/21, Towns (illness) is questionable and Clarkson is out; the line fell from Knicks -5.5 to -2.5 (ESPN, 11/21).

401910028.summary: Boston ruled out Jayson Tatum and Derrick White at SAC; our ratings assume both play, which covers most of the 3.5-point gap.
